faq.a1: I make original greeting cards by hand, with attention to paper, texture and the words they will carry. For the jewelry collection, I select work made by independent artisans in Japan, with a focus on their design, materials and craftsmanship.
faq.a2: For the jewelry collection, I select work made by independent artisans in Japan, with a focus on their design, materials and craftsmanship. Our collections share a love of texture, considered design and the people behind the work.
faq.a3: Small variations can be part of handcraft; any notable details are described in the listing. Look closely at the materials, finish and small details that give each handmade piece its character.
faq.a4: Materials and measurements are stated on each product page. Look closely at the materials, finish and small details that give each handmade piece its character.
faq.q5: Can I buy cards and jewelry together?
faq.a5: Choose one card for a personal message. A coordinated set of three cards, priced and stocked separately. Choose each item separately and add them to the same bag. No fixed bundle or automatic discount.
faq.q6: How do shipping and preorders work?
faq.a6: Cards can be bought alone, as a three-card set, or alongside jewelry. Items in the same order are packed and shipped together; the current shipping charge is shown at checkout. If your order includes a preorder, the whole order ships together when all items are ready, by the latest dispatch date shown. Transit time starts after dispatch.

returns.intro: Look closely at the materials, finish and small details that give each handmade piece its character.
returns.policyBody: Every item is carefully inspected, measured and photographed at the time of listing, so what you see is exactly what you'll receive. Because of this, we're unable to accept returns or exchanges once an order has shipped.
returns.beforeBody: Materials and measurements are stated on each product page. Look closely at the materials, finish and small details that give each handmade piece its character.
returns.issueBody: In the rare case your order arrives damaged in transit or doesn't match its listing, contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photos and we'll work with you to make it right.

brand.title: Small things, made with care
brand.lead: orangekoko is a place for handmade objects with a personal point of view.
brand.philosophy1: Orange is the warmth of a small gesture: a card written for someone, or a piece chosen to wear every day.
brand.philosophy2: The value is in the making — the choice of paper, a thoughtful shape, a carefully finished detail.
brand.philosophy3: One part created by me, one part made by Japanese artisans. Both belong here because of the care behind them.
brand.philosophy4: Our collections share a love of texture, considered design and the people behind the work.
brand.philosophy5: Look closely at the materials, finish and small details that give each handmade piece its character.
